spec.name: crank_arm
spec.description: Bicycle crank arm 180x40x30 mm in 7075 aluminium. Axle end fixed inside a 20 mm diameter spindle circle through the thickness at (x=20, y=20). Pedal boss of 16 mm diameter at (x=160, y=20) kept solid through the full thickness. A 1.2 kN downward (-y) rider load acts on the boss's outer face at z=30 over the 16 mm circle.

supports.note: keyed 20 mm diameter spindle through the thickness; everything inside the circle is fixed

loads.note: 1.2 kN downward rider push on the boss's outer face (z=30) over the 16 mm circle; the thin span captures only the z=30 node layer

passive.note: threaded pedal boss of 16 mm diameter, kept solid through the full thickness
